subject: Public Comments Form
comment: Please refrain from changing our two lane roads down to a single lane. This is becoming more and more dangerous for motorcyclists within the city. It's well known the mayor hates motorcycles and love bicycles. How can our roads be changed without the citizens voice. The mayor is making it more dangerous to ride a motorcycle. The ratio of motorcycle accidents to bicycle accidents this year is 24:1

comment: Why was north Dixie Downs Drive restriped with only one lane of travel in both directions? It was two lanes of travel on both sides before. Why change it for the few bikes that actually use the bike lanes. Who makes these decisions?
